text:
Andrea: quick help — onboarding Aurora Health (private VPC). Need a compact set of links/snippets I can paste to their infra team: Grafana folder, Prom scrape target, OTLP endpoint for logs/traces, promtail example, and how to give read-only access.

Matt: Grafana: customer folder -> https://grafana.redwood.internal/dashboards/f/priv-vpc/aurora-health 
If they only want the inference overview dashboard use the single-panel link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd1234/inference-overview?orgId=1

Samir: OTLP ingest (TLS): `https://otlp.ingest.redwood:4317`  — we give them a CA bundle + a short-lived bearer token via the onboarding ticket. Promtail example we hand out: 
```
clients:
  - url: "https://otlp.ingest.redwood:4317"
    tls_config:
      ca_file: /etc/redwood/certs/redwood-root.pem
    bearer_token_file: /etc/redwood/secrets/otlp-token
```
Note: keep TLS + token; don't disable cert checks.

Nina: traces live in Tempo and are searchable from Grafana: Observability -> Traces. Use filter `customer_id=\"aurora-health\"` and service tag `service=\"inference\"` to narrow down.

Andrea: nice. One-liner alert they can add for P99 inference latency?

Matt: pasteable Prometheus rule: 
```
- alert: CustomerInferenceHighP99
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(redwood_inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, customer_id)) > 1.5
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: page
  annotations:
    summary: "High P99 inference latency for {{ $labels.customer_id }}"
```
Adjust threshold (1.5s) per model.

Samir: also the recommended scrape endpoint for private scrapes is the scrape-proxy inside their VPC at `10.250.0.12:9100` (we'll confirm exact IP in ticket). We perform scrapes from our side over peering; they should open that IP/port. If they prefer push-based logs, we support S3-forwarder — docs: https://docs.redwood/s3-forwarder.

Andrea: how do we give them Viewer access to only their Grafana folder without adding to org?

Nina: create a folder-scoped API key with Viewer role (obs-onboarding runbook). Short expiry (7 days) is default. Or generate a signed share link for read-only view if they just need a quick peek. Confluence: https://confluence.redwood/obs/private-grafana-onboarding

oncall-bot: created onboarding ticket #OB-8592 for Aurora Health. Assigned SME: @Samir. Link: https://tickets.redwood/OB-8592 :white_check_mark:

Andrea: perfect — I'll send this to their infra. @Samir can you drop the final scrape IP and the token name to the ticket when you have them? :thumbsup:

Samir: will add IP, token filename, and recommended OTLP retry/backoff settings to OB-8592 today.

Matt: small note — if they want minimal ops choose S3-forwarder for logs and use our hosted Prom pushgateway for metrics. Less firewall work.

Andrea: great, thanks all :raised_hands:
